nodes.description: WNT1 is a secreted signaling protein that binds the Frizzled receptor (FZD) and the coreceptor LRP5/6 to activate canonical WNT/beta-catenin signaling. Biallelic loss-of-function or hypofunctional WNT1 variants (frameshift, nonsense, splice-site, missense) yield WNT1 protein that fails to activate canonical LRP5-mediated WNT-regulated beta-catenin signaling, so beta-catenin does not accumulate to induce WNT target genes. This places OI type XV mechanistically apart from the collagen-defect OI types: the proximal lesion is failure of an osteoanabolic signaling ligand rather than a defect in type I collagen.
